subject: Next steps & kickoff checklist — Stratus Health pilot
messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.inference.com>
To: Emma Caldwell <emma.caldwell@stratushealth.io>, Dr. Rajiv Menon <r.menon@stratushealth.io>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.inference.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Fri, 22 May 2026 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Recap & proposed onramp — Stratus Health inference pilot

Thanks again for your time today — appreciated the candid discussion. Below is a short recap of what we heard, proposed pilot scope, and immediate asks so we can kick off next week.

What we heard (pain & goals)
- Pain: high latency on document summarization and errors when handling mixed-format clinical notes (PDF + scanned images).
- Goal: bring end-to-end latency under 300ms p95 for summary generation on common 1–3 page notes, and reduce manual triage time by 40% for the first-pass summarization flow.
- Success criteria: p95 latency target & accuracy measured by ROUGE-L vs. internal gold set; human-in-loop reduction measured by average manual edits per summary.

Proposed pilot (4 weeks) — high level
- Scope: integrate Redwood hosted endpoint for the summary pipeline (batch and streaming), run on 20k notes sampled from your backlog.
- Metrics to measure: token cost per summary, p50/p95 latency, ROUGE-L vs. annotated set, % manual edits.
- Prompt & eval plan: we’ll ship an initial prompt set (10 seed prompts + 100 eval pairs) and run nightly evals to track regressions.
- Owners:
  - Redwood: Hannah (eng lead/PM), Rishi (inference/runtime contact)
  - Stratus: Emma (product), Rajiv (clinical SME)
- Timeline
  - Week 0 (this week): access + sample export + naming convention for notes
  - Week 1: environment setup, initial prompt tuning, baseline run
  - Week 2: iterative prompt/eval cycles + latency tuning (batching/kv cache)
  - Week 3: stability run, handover of monitoring dashboard
  - Week 4: recap, decision checkpoint (expand/stop)

Immediate asks (please):
1) Provide S3 export of 2k representative notes (PHI-neutralized) and a small gold set (50 annotated notes) by Monday 2026-05-25 EOD.
2) Add our service account (redwood-pilot@stratus-svc) to the export bucket with read access — network checklist attached.
3) Confirm procurement rep so we can route the contract redline if needed.

Attachments: stratus-poc-scope-v1.pdf (POC scope & success criteria), network-access-checklist.xlsx (access steps + firewall rules).

If that aligns, I’ll send a calendar invite for a 30m kickoff and a shared folder with the prompt/eval template.

Thanks,
Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference

Hannah — thanks for the thorough recap. High level OK from our side; a few clarifications and notes:

1) Metrics: ROUGE-L is fine as a baseline, but can we also capture a binary clinical-safety flag (false negatives on critical items) in the eval set? Rajiv will work with us on labeling.
2) Export: we can deliver a 2k export but it will be staggered (1k Monday, 1k Wednesday) due to compliance scanning.
3) Access: IT will need the network checklist filled out; I’ve looped procurement on this thread (procurement@stratushealth.io) for contracting cadence.

Procurement note: we typically need a short SOW and a PO. I’ll share the contact.

We’re OK to start the kickoff on Tuesday (2026-05-26) morning PT — propose 10:00am PT.

Thanks,
Emma
